To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
model-based RL depends on the hippocampal relational memory system.

(1) human performance in a learning and generalisation task that involves relational memory (acquired equivalence task) correlates with performance in a sequential RL task (sequential decision making) that can be solved by either model-based or model free RL strategy; and (2) the correlation between the two tasks is specific for model-based, but no model-free, strategy in the sequential decision making task.
model-based reinforcement learning is positively correlated with relational memory, as indexed by generalization in an acquired equivalence task.
